content:
You can monitor the SearchOCU and IndexingOCU account-level CloudWatch metrics to
understand how your collections are scaling. We recommend that you conﬁgure alarms to notify
you if your account is approaching a threshold for metrics related to capacity, so you can adjust
your capacity settings accordingly.
You can also use these metrics to determine if your maximum capacity settings are appropriate, or
if you need to adjust them. Analyze these metrics to focus your eﬀorts for optimizing the eﬃciency
of your collections. For more information about the metrics that OpenSearch Serverless sends to
CloudWatch, see the section called “Monitoring OpenSearch Serverless”.

hierarchy.parent: Managing capacity limits for Amazon OpenSearch Serverless
